name: Fresh Seal
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 2 rounds
Components V, S, M (a wooden carving of a piece of food)

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.
Target up to 2 full meals (food and drink)/level
Duration 1 week/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell restores spoiled food and drink in its range to their unspoiled condition. Unlike purify food and drink, the affected food and drink are preserved from further spoilage.
